# OpenRigGraph

> Renderer-neutral character rig graph runtime documentation. Running examples
> requires an existing ORG SDK; this is a docs-only distribution.

## Start
- [Getting started](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/getting_started.html)
- [Agent workflow](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/porting/agent_workflow.html)
- [Synthetic tutorial](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/porting/tutorial.html)
- [Graph nodes](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/nodes/index.html)
- [Maya integration](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/maya/index.html)
- [C API](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/reference/c_api.html)
- [Python API](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/reference/python_api.html)
- [CLI](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/reference/cli.html)
- [Representation decisions](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/porting/design_decisions.html)
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://zukunfcs.github.io/OpenRigGraph-docs/node_catalog.json)
